description:
**Severity: high · Dimension: unsafe-isolation** (report finding #2, widened 2026-08-07)

Four `pub unsafe fn` in `crates/gf2-kernels-simd/src/x86/fp_generic.rs` (lines 155, 229, 266, 296: `fp_montgomery_mul4`, `fp_montgomery_batch_mul`, `fp_montgomery_batch_add`, `fp_montgomery_batch_sub`) have no `# Safety` doc section and no `// SAFETY:` comments before their `get_unchecked` / raw-pointer dereferences.

A crate-wide `#![allow(clippy::missing_safety_doc)]` in `lib.rs:1` plus 15 per-module copies silence Clippy enforcement across the whole crate, papering over the root cause. This issue owns the full removal: a 2026-08-07 measurement over the ~20 files declaring `pub unsafe fn` found only two deficient — `x86/fp_generic.rs` (4 declarations, no `# Safety` section) and `x86/bipedal_avx2.rs` (5 declarations, 4 sections). The remaining modules already document their unsafe surface, so the allows are removable for roughly five functions of real work.

Project invariant: all `unsafe` lives in the kernel crates AND every `pub unsafe fn` carries a `// SAFETY:` comment (@/inv/unsafe-kernel-isolation, AGENTS.md invariant #3).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The four `fp_generic` functions gain a `# Safety` doc section stating AVX2-availability and input-validity preconditions.
- [hard] REQ-02: A `// SAFETY:` comment precedes each unsafe operation site (`get_unchecked` / raw-pointer deref) in the four `fp_generic` functions.
- [hard] REQ-03: Every `pub unsafe fn` in `gf2-kernels-simd` carries a `# Safety` section; the undocumented declaration(s) in `x86/bipedal_avx2.rs` are covered alongside `fp_generic`.
- [hard] REQ-04: All 16 `#![allow(clippy::missing_safety_doc)]` attributes are removed — `lib.rs:1` and the 15 module-level copies — and clippy passes with `-D warnings` afterwards with no replacement allow at any scope.
- [hard] REQ-05: Full `cargo nextest --profile ci`, clippy, and fmt pass.

## Notes

This issue is the sole owner of the `missing_safety_doc` removal. The overlapping bullet was removed from `aabc528a` on 2026-08-07 to avoid a split owner.
title: Document safety contracts and restore clippy enforcement in gf2-kernels-simd
